listing.name: Planetary Shield Replacer by ShogunTrooper
listing.summary: A quick and simple Shield Replacer, made due to the fact that the Vanilla one was a bit too overbearing for my tastes, and kinda killed the planet it was built on aesthetically by turning it into a red stop light. Seeing as I couldn't find a Mod for that, I did it myself.
listing.aiSummary: Replaces the vanilla planetary shield with a less overbearing design that shows the planet beneath better.

description:
A quick and simple Shield Replacer, made due to the fact that the Vanilla one was a bit too overbearing for my tastes, and kinda killed the planet it was built on aesthetically by turning it into a red stop light. Seeing as I couldn't find a Mod for that, I did it myself.

DOWNLOAD HERE

This one is supposed to show the planet beneath a little bit better, without removing the shield's red aesthetic entirely. It comes in 7 different designs, shown in the example above being the default, and the spoiler below showing the options, with the ReadMe including instructions how to change them.

Alternate Designs

I do consider adding color options for it as well, if there is enough demand for it, but this is it for now.
